behavior.arguments: rdi = destination pointer receiving 48 bytes; rsi = source struct pointer; rdx = pointer to the struct holding the index field at +0x14; ecx = signed 32-bit index bound; r8b = flag byte.

edges.all_gates_pass: flag nonzero, field 5 with bound 4 (edx 4, not greater), gate byte nonzero: path A, dest bytes equal source bytes at +0x188..+0x1b8.
edges.bound_boundary: field 5 with bound 4 gives edx 4, which is not greater than 4, so the range gate passes.
edges.flag_zero: flag byte 0 selects path B regardless of the index field, the bound, and the gate byte.
edges.gate_zero: gate byte 0 selects path B regardless of the index field and the bound.
edges.index_over: field 5 with bound 3 gives edx 4, which is greater than 3, so path B is selected.
edges.zero_field: field 0 with bound -1 gives edx -1, which is not greater than -1, so the range gate passes.

behavior.entry_shape: Opens with endbr64; three forward conditional branches, all to the shared path-B block at 0x4ff8b78; a 5-byte nopl between the path-A ret and the path-B block is intra-body alignment padding; two rets; no calls inside.
behavior.return_rule: No return value claimed: rax is set to rdi on entry and path B stores through rax, but the packet claims only the 48-byte destination write. No field besides the 48 destination bytes is written.

coordinate_system: ELF virtual addresses, without a guessed loader or Ghidra rebase. The ELF section table maps .text with file offset = VA - 0x1000; the retained .eh_frame has equal file offset and VA. The tools resolve sections rather than assuming one global VA/file-offset relationship.

incoming_pattern_scan.note: Byte-pattern scan over the full .text section (70,370,352 bytes) for e8 sites whose rel32 lands on the window start; eight sites found, each confirmed as an instruction start by linear disassembly from its caller FDE start. This is explicitly not a complete xref census: indirect calls, tail jumps, and PLT references are out of scope for the scan.
incoming_pattern_scan.relocation_note: No relocation record of any type in any .rela.* section names this window as addend (full-section scan: 80,022 .rela.dyn + 278 .rela.plt entries).
